parameter.name: initgroups_mode
parameter.description:
Controls which supplementary groups Himmelblau returns from NSS initgroups.
.RS .IP \(bu 2 named \(em return only groups that resolve to an NSS name (default). A GID that .B getgrgid cannot name is omitted, so tools such as .B groups do not fail on an unnamed group id. .IP \(bu 2 full \(em return every cached group GID, including ones with no NSS name. Use this when debugging a missing membership. .RE
parameter.conf_description: Supplementary groups: named only, or every cached GID.
